# What the Arch build containers need: the libraries the build links
# against, and the ones quick-sharun has to find to bundle them.
#
# alsa-lib is the same requirement as libasound2-dev on Debian: cpal reaches
# ALSA through alsa-sys, which needs the library to compile against. It is
# also what quick-sharun traces when it bundles the runtime library.
alsa-lib

# The sound server has to be installed before quick-sharun runs, since it
# copies only what the build host has. pulseaudio carries libpulse, which
# the ALSA plugin loads, and the server that plugin talks to;
# pulseaudio-alsa is the plugin itself and the 99-pulseaudio-default.conf
# that points the default PCM at it. Only the AppImage job deploys them,
# but both jobs read this list.
pulseaudio
pulseaudio-alsa
